info.title: FinAgent API
info.description: Upload Excel/CSV workbooks, run deterministic analysis with an LLM-written summary, and export reports. Successful responses use `{ data, meta }`; errors use `{ error: { code, message, details, requestId } }`.

cached.description: Result reused from an identical earlier analysis (no LLM cost)

verification.description: Numbers in the narrative checked against computed values

refreshToken.description: Single-use; every refresh returns a new one

headerRow.description: 1-based worksheet row of the header; 0 if none was found

notFound.description: Requested tokens that this file does not contain

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Shown only once, at creation.

post.summary: Start an analysis of a READY file
post.description: Statistics and anomalies are computed in code; the LLM only narrates them from masked data. Identical requests on identical content reuse the earlier result (201, `cached: true`). Otherwise the job is queued (202); follow `analysis:progress` on the socket or poll GET /api/analyses/{id}.

get.summary: Analysis status and, once completed, its result
Ready-to-render chart specs for a completed analysis
get.description: Computed deterministically in code from the stored rows (never by the LLM): anomalies by type and severity, a time series, histograms of up to 3 numeric columns, top values of up to 2 low-cardinality text columns, activity by hour and missing values per column. Charts whose columns are missing are skipped. Labels come from masked data, so they may be tokens such as `[PERSON_3]` (reveal with POST /api/files/{id}/unmask). Every series has at most 200 points (`meta.truncated` keeps the latest 200). Titles follow the analysis language. Cached per content and chart version.

post.summary: Reveal the original values behind masked PII tokens
post.description: The only way to see raw PII. Rows, anomalies, summaries and charts carry tokens such as `[PERSON_3]`; send the ones to reveal with a justification. Same file visibility as GET /api/files/{id} (analysts: own files), further limited to the roles in `UNMASK_ALLOWED_ROLES`. Audited as pii.unmask with the reason, token count and token types (never the values); rate limited per user; responses are `Cache-Control: no-store`.

post.summary: Subscribe a URL to analysis events (admin)
post.description: Deliveries are POSTed with `X-FinAgent-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>")` and `X-FinAgent-Timestamp`. URLs that resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses are rejected; https is required in production.
